**Direct answer:** Jürgen Aschoff studied medicine at the University of Bonn. One source suggests he may also have studied at other universities, so the answer is not fully settled.

- Wikipedia says he studied medicine at the University of Bonn, and it names no other university where he studied medicine: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%BCrgen_Aschoff
- He moved to the University of Göttingen in 1938 to work on thermoregulation physiology under Hermann Rein. Wikipedia describes this as a research position, not medical study: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%BCrgen_Aschoff
- The search summary of the Auk obituary says he went on from Bonn to Göttingen, Würzburg and Heidelberg. I did not read the obituary itself, so I haven't confirmed that: https://bioone.org/journals/the-auk/volume-117/issue-3/0004-8038_2000_117_0779_IMJRA_2.0.CO_2/IN-MEMORIAM-J%C3%9CRGEN-ASCHOFF-19131998/10.1642/0004-8038(2000)117%5B0779:IMJRA%5D2.0.CO;2.full
- The search summary says Wikidata lists Heidelberg and Freiburg as places he was educated. I did not open the Wikidata page: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q75270

**Caveat:** Bonn is the university named for his medical studies. The other universities may be places where he continued his studies or his career. I did not open the Auk obituary or the Wikidata page, so I can't say which.
